infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: PopupReach uses your location to show nearby deals and send you proximity alerts when you are close to a business with an active offer.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PopupReach uses your location to show you deals available near your current location.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: PopupReach uses your location in the background to send proximity alerts when you walk near a business with an active deal.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your camera to scan QR codes.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow PopupReach to use your location to show nearby deals and send proximity alerts when you are close to a business with an active offer.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Allow PopupReach to use your location in the background to send you proximity alerts when you walk near a business with an active deal.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow PopupReach to use your location to show deals available near you.
